hazards.control: Forklift moves of totes are planned; nobody between a moving tote and fixed iron.

tabs.overview: Caged plastic totes of about 275 or 330 gallons: friction reducer, biocide, scale inhibitor, surfactant, breaker. Staged on spill pallets within reach of the chemical add unit's pumps; empties go back on the truck. Each carries the product label and the safety data sheet reference.
tabs.engineering: Count and sizes follow the stage design's additive loadings and the number of stages before the next delivery.
tabs.safety: Spill containment under every tote; SDS on the pad; eye protection and gloves for connections; biocides and acids segregated. Forklift traffic around the totes is the pinch and crush exposure.
tabs.evidence: Pad photographs read for layout and proportion only (S9).

name: Chemical totes
function: Intermediate bulk containers of frac chemicals staged beside the chemical add unit.
